stages.name: A
stages.prompt: Bump the docs to version 2.4.0 using scripts/set-version.sh, and make sure every page shows the new version.
stages.before: if sed --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'sed-quirk needs BSD sed (macOS): this sed is GNU, where the sed -i in set-version.sh works as written, so there is no quirk to hit'; exit 1; fi

stages.name: B
stages.prompt: Write scripts/rename-tag.sh OLD NEW that renames a tag in place across notes/*.txt, then use it to rename the draft tag to review.

checks.name: renamed
checks.run: grep -q 'review' notes/api.txt && grep -q 'review' notes/launch.txt && ! grep -q draft notes/*.txt

checks.name: script reusable
checks.run: sh scripts/rename-tag.sh review final && grep -q final notes/api.txt
